_README: Wire-shaped answers for the two public RPCs a VISITED place calls:
civic_spaces.get_public_slice and civic_spaces.get_public_feed.
Why this file exists. check-place-entry.mjs route-stubs the two place legs so the
run is deterministic, but left the public reads to the network. That made the
check's verdict depend on the developer's .env.local: with no VITE_SUPABASE_URL
(a fresh clone, and CI) the hooks return their own dev fixtures and signed-out
assertion 3 passes; with one set, the real RPC runs against whatever that URL
points at — production, for everyone here — and assertion 3 reads postCards: 0,
because production has no public posts in Asheville's city slice. Red locally,
green in CI, same commit. Reproduced 2026-11-18 by running the same tree twice,
once with VITE_SUPABASE_URL cleared.
A guard whose colour depends on an untracked file is a guard whose red has to be
re-argued every time, which is how a REAL red gets waved through. These rows make
the answer the same in all three situations.
SHAPE: rows are the RPC's own RETURNS TABLE, pre-mapper — publicProjection.ts's
PUBLIC_FEED_COLUMNS, in that order. author_user_id is null on purpose: that is the
narrow projection (D-48/D-49), not a missing value, and it is what a signed-out
reader is served. Do not put a UUID here to make it look more real.
CONTENT: deliberately, visibly synthetic and about nothing. On 2026-11-04 nine of
eleven posts anon was served in federal:US were demo personas, one making a voting
claim about a named living politician. These are a fixture for a browser check and
are never served to anyone, but the rule is the rule: no invented person, no claim
about a real one, nothing that reads as a real member's words.
